# Dauntless Revived

> Dauntless Revived is a private, non-commercial server revival of Dauntless, the Phoenix Labs co-op monster-hunting game whose official servers shut down on 30 May 2025. It runs the genuine Dauntless 1.4.4 client (October 2020, Unreal Engine 4) against a self-hosted fork of the open-source Undaunted server by gwog and contributors (AGPL-3.0).

- It is not a public server. It is run for a few friends, and anyone with their own copy of the 1.4.4 client can host the same thing from the source code (https://github.com/mixutin/dauntless-revived).
- Status as of September 2026: it works for one player on the host PC. That covers login with a personal account key (no Epic account needed), the tutorial, Ramsgate, the Training Dojo, hunts and crafting. Items, gear and quests are saved and backed up hourly. Slayer level, mastery and the Hunt Pass (with the Elite pass for every account) are saved too: real progression is on by default and passed an in-game test on a throwaway account. Not yet working: playing with friends over the internet, parties and the friends list, bounties. The home page and the roadmap have the current state.
- No game files are distributed by the site or the repository. Every player needs their own copy of the client.
- Not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by Phoenix Labs or Epic Games. "Dauntless" is a trademark of its owners.
- Built on Undaunted (https://github.com/SyST3MDeV/Undaunted) by gwog (Gregory Morford) and contributors: the server-mode DLL, the deploy server, the metagame backend and the launcher are theirs.

## Start here

- [Home](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/): Dauntless Revived is a private server revival of Dauntless: the genuine 1.4.4 client on a self-hosted fork of Undaunted. What works and how to set it up.
- [FAQ](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/faq.html): Can you still play Dauntless? Is there a private server? Short answers about Dauntless Revived: versions, Epic accounts, joining, hosting, legality and Linux.

## Setup

- [Setup](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/setup/): How to run Dauntless Revived: host the Undaunted-based private server on one Windows PC, let invited friends join, run it for a group, and fix common problems.
- [Host a server](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/setup/host.html): Step-by-step guide to hosting a Dauntless 1.4.4 private server on one Windows PC: verify the build, place the two DLLs, set up the metagame and deploy server.
- [Join as a friend](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/setup/friends.html): How an invited friend joins a Dauntless Revived server: Tailscale, a hash-checked Dauntless 1.4.4 install, the two DLLs, an invite code and the friend kit.
- [Run it for a group](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/setup/admin.html): Opening a Dauntless Revived server to a few friends: Tailscale sharing, firewall rules, invite codes, admin accounts, capacity figures and database backups.
- [Troubleshooting](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/setup/troubleshooting.html): Problems we hit running the Dauntless 1.4.4 client against an Undaunted server, with causes and fixes: port clashes, login, blurry graphics, Defender and git.
- [Windows server kit](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/setup/windows-server.html): Install a Dauntless Revived server on a rented Windows Server 2019 VPS in public mode: one TLS gateway port with a pinned certificate, game ports opened only for logged-in players, key-only SSH deployment, invites, updates and backups.
- [Upgrade notes](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/setup/upgrading.html): What changes for players when you update an existing Dauntless Revived server: real progression is now on by default. How to keep old max ranks, start fresh, or stay on the stub.

## Findings

- [Findings](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/findings/): What we learned about how the online side of Dauntless worked, from the 1.4.4 and 2.1.1 clients: backend contract, client internals, multiplayer and crashes.
- [Verifying game files](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/findings/verification.html): How we checked that community-shared Dauntless builds are genuine, complete and clean: Authenticode signatures, Phoenix Labs' install manifest and ClamAV.
- [Game assets and config](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/findings/assets.html): How the Dauntless 1.4.4 and 2.1.1 builds store content: pak v9 and IoStore containers, Oodle, the cooked config, key map paths and the user config folder.
- [Backend contract](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/findings/backend-contract.html): The Dauntless backend API recovered from the client: steelyard.ca hosts (not PlayFab), the response envelope, login, characters, inventory and matchmaking.
- [Reading the JSON contract from the binary](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/findings/json-reversing.html): How we recovered the JSON response shapes of Dauntless from the shipped 2.1.1 binary with no symbols: handlers, Serialize functions, envelopes and mistakes.
- [Client internals](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/findings/client-internals.html): What the shipped Dauntless client can and cannot do on its own: a client-only build, launch and login switches, logging, the hang detector and ini overrides.
- [How multiplayer works](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/findings/multiplayer.html): How Undaunted runs multiplayer on the client-only Dauntless 1.4.4 build: an injected DLL turns extra client copies into game servers for Ramsgate and hunts.
- [Crash forensics](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/findings/crashes.html): Crash forensics for a Dauntless client with no symbols or log file: turning crash reports into instruction addresses, and what each crash turned out to be.
- [The 2.1.1 standalone attempt](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/findings/awakening-2-1-1.html): Our first attempt on the final Dauntless 2.1.1 client: a full login chain against our own backend, Ramsgate rendered, and why no controllable player appeared.

## Project

- [Roadmap](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/roadmap.html): The Dauntless Revived roadmap: what already works, and milestones M0 to M4, from a safety net and playing together to saved progression and the full game loop.
- [Tools](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/tools.html): Three small Python scripts behind our Dauntless analysis: xref.py for PE string cross-references, utocdir.py for IoStore, pak9.py for pak v9, plus libooz.
- [Credits and license](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/legal.html): Credits for Undaunted by gwog and contributors, what the AGPL-3.0 asks of anyone who hosts a modified server, and why no Dauntless game files are shared here.
- [Source code on GitHub](https://github.com/mixutin/dauntless-revived): The fork's complete source, AGPL-3.0-only, on branch dauntless-revived.
- [ROADMAP.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mixutin/dauntless-revived/dauntless-revived/ROADMAP.md): The live checklist behind the roadmap page, as raw Markdown. Done items start with "- [x] **<id>", open ones with "- [ ] **<id>".

## Suomeksi (the Finnish version of the site, in plain language)

- [Dauntless Revived suomeksi](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/): Dauntless Revived on yksityinen palvelin, jolla Dauntlessia voi taas pelata: aito 1.4.4-versio ja muokattu Undaunted. Mikä toimii ja miten sen saa käyttöön.
- [Asennus](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/setup/): Näin Dauntless Revived otetaan käyttöön: oma palvelin Windows-koneelle, kavereiden liittyminen, palvelin ryhmälle ja yleisimpien ongelmien korjaus.
- [Pystytä palvelin](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/setup/host.html): Vaiheittainen ohje Dauntless 1.4.4 -yksityispalvelimen pystyttämiseen Windows-koneelle: version tarkistus, kaksi DLL-tiedostoa, metagame ja deploy-palvelin.
- [Liity kaverina](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/setup/friends.html): Näin kutsuttu kaveri liittyy Dauntless Revived -palvelimelle: Tailscale, tarkistettu Dauntless 1.4.4, kaksi DLL-tiedostoa, kutsukoodi ja kaveripaketti.
- [Palvelin ryhmälle](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/setup/admin.html): Dauntless Revived -palvelin kavereille: Tailscale-jako, palomuurisäännöt, kutsukoodit, ylläpitäjän tilit, kapasiteetti ja tietokannan varmuuskopiot.
- [Vianetsintä](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/setup/troubleshooting.html): Dauntless 1.4.4 ja Undaunted-palvelin: ongelmat, joihin törmäsimme, syineen ja korjauksineen. Varatut portit, kirjautuminen, sumea grafiikka, Defender ja git.
- [Windows-palvelin](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/setup/windows-server.html): Dauntless Revived -palvelin vuokratulle Windows Server 2019 -koneelle julkisessa tilassa: yksi salattu portti, kiinnitetty varmenne, peliportit auki vain kirjautuneille, asennus SSH:lla, kutsut ja varmuuskopiot.
- [Päivitysohjeet](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/setup/upgrading.html): Mitä pelaajille muuttuu, kun päivität jo käytössä olevan Dauntless Revived -palvelimen: oikea eteneminen on nyt oletuksena päällä. Näin pidät vanhat maksimitasot, aloitat alusta tai jatkat tyngällä.
- [Löydökset](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/findings/): Mitä Dauntlessin verkkopuolesta on saatu selville kahdesta peliversiosta: tiedostojen tarkistus, asetukset, taustapalvelun rajapinta, moninpeli ja kaatumiset.
- [Pelitiedostojen tarkistaminen](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/findings/verification.html): Miten varmistimme, että yhteisön arkistoimat Dauntless-versiot 2.1.1 ja 1.4.4 ovat aitoja, ehjiä ja puhtaita: allekirjoitukset, manifestit ja virustarkistus.
- [Pelin sisältö ja asetukset](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/findings/assets.html): Miten Dauntlessin versiot 2.1.1 ja 1.4.4 tallentavat sisältönsä ja asetuksensa, miten niitä luetaan ja mitä käyttäjän asetustiedostolla voi muuttaa.
- [Taustapalvelun rajapinta](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/findings/backend-contract.html): Dauntlessin taustapalvelut steelyard.ca-palvelimilla (ei PlayFab): palvelinnimet, kuorisäännöt ja vastausten muodot, selvitetty pelin omasta koodista.
- [JSON-rakenteen lukeminen ohjelmatiedostosta](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/findings/json-reversing.html): Miten Dauntless 2.1.1:n koodista selvitettiin palvelinvastausten kenttien nimet, JSON-tyypit ja kuoret, sekä matkan varrella tehdyt virheet ja opetukset.
- [Asiakasohjelman sisäosat](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/findings/client-internals.html): Mitä Dauntlessin peliohjelma osaa yksinään ja mitä ei: käynnistysvalitsimet, kirjautuminen, lokit, telemetria ja jumiutumisen tunnistin (2.1.1 ja 1.4.4).
- [Näin moninpeli toimii](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/findings/multiplayer.html): Miten Undaunted tekee Dauntless 1.4.4 -peliohjelman kopioista pelipalvelimia DLL-tiedoston avulla, ja miksi luulimme kerran moninpelin olevan mahdoton.
- [Kaatumisten tutkiminen](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/findings/crashes.html): Miten Dauntlessin kaatumisraportit muutetaan konekielen osoitteiksi, ja mistä kukin kohtaamamme kaatuminen johtui. Suurin osa koskee versiota 2.1.1.
- [Itsenäinen käynnistys 2.1.1:llä](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/findings/awakening-2-1-1.html): Kokeilu käynnistää Dauntless 2.1.1 suoraan Ramsgateen ilman pelipalvelinta: mikä toimi, mihin jäimme (tyhjä tilitunnus) ja mistä työtä voi jatkaa.
- [Tiekartta](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/roadmap.html): Dauntless Revivedin tiekartta selkokielellä: tavoite, välitavoitteet M0–M4, mitä on jo tehty ja mitä on työn alla. Päivittyvä lista on englanniksi.
- [Usein kysyttyä](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/faq.html): Voiko Dauntlessia vielä pelata? Onko sille yksityistä palvelinta? Lyhyet vastaukset Dauntless Revivedistä: versio, Epic-tili, liittyminen ja oma palvelin.
- [Työkalut](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/tools.html): Kolme pientä Python-työkalua Dauntlessin tutkimiseen: xref.py ohjelmatiedoston merkkijonoille, utocdir.py IoStore-säiliöille ja pak9.py pak-tiedostoille.
- [Kiitokset ja lisenssi](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/legal.html): Keiden työn varaan Dauntless Revived on rakennettu (ennen kaikkea Undaunted), mitä AGPL-3.0 käytännössä vaatii ja miksi sivustolla ei ole pelitiedostoja.
